description: High-level national and international market watch used as editorial context. This is reporting context, not stock advice.

groups.title: US market risk appetite
groups.thesis: Broad US risk-on/risk-off movement changes appetite for new SaaS spending, AI tooling, and experimental product bets.
groups.productImplication: Weak broad risk appetite raises the editorial importance of cost pressure, capital efficiency, and near-term business impact.

tickers.name: Nasdaq 100 ETF
tickers.role: US growth and AI software beta

groups.title: US AI infrastructure bellwethers
groups.thesis: AI infrastructure equities are a fast proxy for whether the market is rewarding compute, chips, cloud, and model-platform expansion.
groups.productImplication: Strength raises the relevance of AI infrastructure expansion; weakness raises the relevance of cost control, utilization, and buyer-proof stories.

groups.title: International AI supply chain
groups.thesis: International semiconductor and platform bellwethers show whether AI demand is broadening outside US mega-cap narratives.
groups.productImplication: Synchronized moves raise the relevance of cross-border supply, policy, capacity, and capital-expenditure reporting.
